title: Match Group reports Q3 revenue fell 3% YoY to $891M, below estimates, and total paying users fell 5% to 13.8M; Q4 forecast has adjusted EBITDA below estimates (Samantha Kelly/Bloomberg)
summary: Samantha Kelly / Bloomberg: Match Group reports Q3 revenue fell 3% YoY to $891M, below estimates, and total paying users fell 5% to 13.8M; Q4 forecast has adjusted EBITDA below estimates — Match Group Inc. disappointed investors after posting weaker-than-expected quarterly revenue and forecasting adjusted earnings …
